content: Super Intelligence WILL EAT MANY ENTIRE businesses, industries and professions in the next few *months* and *quarters*. The rest will follow. The physical world will take a bit longer. That needs A LOT of humanoid robots. Strap yourselves in.

This is both neat & a sign of why it is proving to be so hard to isolate agents from each other. They share a common "brain" which means they don't have a lot of trouble recognizing creative communication solutions generated by other AIs Wonder if it works across model families? We asked two isolated copies of the same AI to exchange a secret word with only a robot and a camera. They succeeded by using air-writing, Morse code, flag semaphore and a 5-bit binary alphabet, without agreeing on a protocol beforehand.

Less than three years ago, GPT-4 was the best model in the world, as it had been for a year, and we were all speculating whether there was some unique secret method that OpenAI had or whether GPT-4 was just as good as LLMs would ever get. (The answer to both questions was "no") The recent releases of many GPT-3.5 class AIs (Grok, Mixtral, Gemini Pro) are oddly unilluminating about the future of frontier AI It’s been a year & no one has beat GPT-4. Will they? Is there some magic there? Does it indicate a limit to LLMs? Will GPT-4.5 be another huge jump?
